name: BFS Light Propagation
definition: A breadth-first search flood-fill algorithm that propagates light levels across a padded voxel chunk, attenuating by 1 per step through non-opaque blocks.
summary: BFS Light Propagation is a voxel-based algorithm that efficiently illuminates non-opaque blocks by propagating light levels across a full 3D chunk using Breadth-First Search with explicit distance attenuation.
